text.zh: 标题写实际主题对象，禁止使用抽象等式或概念口号；禁止添加“给某某人的认知框架”等居高临下的定位性副标题。
text.en: Write titles about the actual subject; do not use abstract equations or conceptual slogans. Do not add condescending positioning subtitles such as "a cognitive framework for so-and-so".

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 为文档、章节或图表拟定标题与副标题时
trigger.en: When writing titles and subtitles for documents, sections or charts

purpose.zh: 让标题直接指向实际主题对象，避免居高临下的定位
purpose.en: Make titles point straight at the actual subject and avoid a condescending tone

exclude.zh: 没有标题的正文段落与对话回复
exclude.en: Body paragraphs without titles and conversational replies
